* Support pydantic-ai 2.60+ and opensandbox 1.2 in common.ai provider

pydantic-ai 2.60 records a durable streamed model request as the bare
response rather than a response-plus-events wrapper, so replaying or
tracking a streamed request in AirflowDurability failed to decode it.
The same release answers a tool retry with the call's own ToolReturnPart
(outcome "retried") instead of RetryPromptPart, which broke tests that
told retries from results by part type.

opensandbox 1.2 allows an egress rule with ports and no target. When the
enforced policy did not match the requested one, sorting the allowed
targets for the error message raised TypeError on that None, hiding the
real reason the sandbox was refused.

Both work with the older releases too, which the provider still supports.

* Fix provider tests and type checks after the dependency upgrade

The tool-part predicates in the common.ai tests returned a plain bool, so
mypy could not narrow the message part they matched and the providers
type check failed.

snowflake-sqlalchemy to 2.1. connector 5.1's connect() no longer goes
through SnowflakeConnection, so patching that class stopped intercepting
the connection and the test tried a real login. snowflake-sqlalchemy
2.0.0 started percent-encoding "?" in the URL password, which the URI
test pinned to the older, unencoded form. Older Python versions keep the
earlier releases, so both tests have to accept either.

  never imported by `llama-index-core`, which uses only the Punkt
  tokenizer and the stopwords corpus.

Upstream merged the fix on nltk's develop branch (nltk/nltk#3757,
nltk/nltk#3759, nltk/nltk#3813) after v3.10.3 was tagged, so the check
stays red until nltk 3.10.4 ships. Drop the entry once it does.
